notes.subject: תחש
notes.rationale: Tahash: animal with fur — badger (KJV), seal (JPS), antelope, fine leather (BSB); fur-bearing animal ka tɔgɔ tiɲɛna ma dɔn.

notes.subject: בשש
notes.rationale: Shesh: bleached stuff, white linen; 'marble' fana b'a kɔnɔ.

notes.subject: Jerusalem
notes.rationale: Yawe ka kuma sinsinnen Yerushalayim kan ma, a fɛn min kɛra a ye a ka daminɛ na o jira.

translation: N ye i don nunu-dalanw na, n ye i cɛ fanga don tanw-nɔnibilen bolo-na, n ye warigwɛ semi ɲɔgɔn i kun na, n ye i datugu ni fɛfɛfɛ ye min bɔra kokɔnɔ nwɛnɛ na.
